cards.back:
Large in size. A basic word for something large.
Bahasa Indonesia: besar
Example: A big truck blocked the narrow village road for ten minutes.
cards.say: big. Large in size. A basic word for something large. A big truck blocked the narrow village road for ten minutes.

cards.back:
Very, very big, much bigger than usual.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat besar
Example: An enormous whale swam slowly beneath our small wooden boat.
cards.say: enormous. Very, very big, much bigger than usual. An enormous whale swam slowly beneath our small wooden boat.

cards.back:
Very small.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat kecil
Example: A tiny ant carried a crumb across the kitchen table.
cards.say: tiny. Very small. A tiny ant carried a crumb across the kitchen table.

cards.back:
To move on foot at a normal speed.
Bahasa Indonesia: berjalan
Example: We walk to school together with our neighbours every morning.
cards.say: walk. To move on foot at a normal speed. We walk to school together with our neighbours every morning.

cards.back:
To walk slowly and happily for pleasure.
Bahasa Indonesia: berjalan santai
Example: Families stroll along the beach in the cool evening.
cards.say: stroll. To walk slowly and happily for pleasure. Families stroll along the beach in the cool evening.

cards.back:
To walk with heavy, noisy steps, often when angry.
Bahasa Indonesia: menghentakkan kaki
Example: He stomped up the stairs and slammed his door.
cards.say: stomp. To walk with heavy, noisy steps, often when angry. He stomped up the stairs and slammed his door.

cards.back:
A plain word for speaking.
Bahasa Indonesia: berkata
Example: She said that the bus would arrive soon.
cards.say: said. A plain word for speaking. She said that the bus would arrive soon.

cards.back:
Spoke very softly so that few people could hear.
Bahasa Indonesia: berbisik
Example: He whispered the secret into his friend's ear.
cards.say: whispered. Spoke very softly so that few people could hear. He whispered the secret into his friend's ear.

cards.back:
Spoke in a very loud voice.
Bahasa Indonesia: berteriak
Example: The coach shouted to the players across the noisy field.
cards.say: shouted. Spoke in a very loud voice. The coach shouted to the players across the noisy field.

cards.back:
Feeling pleasure.
Bahasa Indonesia: senang
Example: The happy children played games in the garden.
cards.say: happy. Feeling pleasure. The happy children played games in the garden.

cards.back:
Feeling extremely happy and excited.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat gembira
Example: She was ecstatic when she heard that she had won.
cards.say: ecstatic. Feeling extremely happy and excited. She was ecstatic when she heard that she had won.

cards.back:
Having a low temperature.
Bahasa Indonesia: dingin
Example: The water in the mountain stream was cold.
cards.say: cold. Having a low temperature. The water in the mountain stream was cold.

cards.back:
Extremely cold.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat dingin
Example: It was freezing on the mountain top, so we wore thick coats.
cards.say: freezing. Extremely cold. It was freezing on the mountain top, so we wore thick coats.

cards.back:
Quick to learn and think.
Bahasa Indonesia: pintar
Example: The smart girl solved the puzzle in a minute.
cards.say: smart. Quick to learn and think. The smart girl solved the puzzle in a minute.

cards.back:
Extremely clever or very good.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat cerdas, hebat
Example: It was a brilliant idea to use a mirror to send the signal.
cards.say: brilliant. Extremely clever or very good. It was a brilliant idea to use a mirror to send the signal.

cards.back:
To turn your eyes towards something.
Bahasa Indonesia: melihat
Example: Look at the colours of the sunset tonight.
cards.say: look. To turn your eyes towards something. Look at the colours of the sunset tonight.

cards.back:
To look quickly for a very short time.
Bahasa Indonesia: melirik
Example: She glanced at the clock and then went back to her book.
cards.say: glance. To look quickly for a very short time. She glanced at the clock and then went back to her book.

cards.back:
To look for a long time without moving your eyes.
Bahasa Indonesia: menatap lekat
Example: The little boy stared at the huge dinosaur skeleton.
cards.say: stare. To look for a long time without moving your eyes. The little boy stared at the huge dinosaur skeleton.

cards.back:
Needing rest or sleep.
Bahasa Indonesia: lelah
Example: The tired runner sat down at the finish line.
cards.say: tired. Needing rest or sleep. The tired runner sat down at the finish line.

cards.back:
So tired that you have no energy left.
Bahasa Indonesia: kelelahan sekali
Example: The exhausted hikers fell asleep as soon as they reached camp.
cards.say: exhausted. So tired that you have no energy left. The exhausted hikers fell asleep as soon as they reached camp.

cards.back:
Afraid.
Bahasa Indonesia: takut
Example: The scared kitten hid under the bed during the loud storm.
cards.say: scared. Afraid. The scared kitten hid under the bed during the loud storm.

cards.back:
Extremely frightened.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat ketakutan
Example: The terrified child held tightly to her mother's hand during the storm.
cards.say: terrified. Extremely frightened. The terrified child held tightly to her mother's hand during the storm.
